seasons.plot: As the bulletproof defender of Harlem, Luke Cage battles corrupt politicians, ruthless gangsters and demons from his own past.

episodes.name: Moment of truth
episodes.plot: With tension building in the streets of Harlem thanks to ruthless club owner Cottonmouth, Luke finds it increasingly difficult to live a quiet life.

translations.value: With tension building in the streets of Harlem thanks to ruthless club owner Cottonmouth, Luke finds it increasingly difficult to live a quiet life.

episodes.name: Code of the streets
episodes.plot: Luke is pulled deeper into the fight for his neighborhood when, as a favor to an old friend, he tries to help a kid who's in trouble with Cottonmouth.

translations.value: Luke is pulled deeper into the fight for his neighborhood when, as a favor to an old friend, he tries to help a kid who's in trouble with Cottonmouth.

episodes.name: Who's gonna take the weight?
episodes.plot: In the aftermath of a chaotic event at a favorite Harlem hangout, Luke heeds the call to action -- and hits Cottonmouth where he'll feel it most.

translations.value: In the aftermath of a chaotic event at a favorite Harlem hangout, Luke heeds the call to action -- and hits Cottonmouth where he'll feel it most.

episodes.name: Step in arena
episodes.plot: As he rescues a victim of Cottonmouth's vengeance, Luke remembers his earlier life and the conspiracy that led to his superhuman strength.

translations.value: As he rescues a victim of Cottonmouth's vengeance, Luke remembers his earlier life and the conspiracy that led to his superhuman strength.

episodes.name: Just to get a rep
episodes.plot: Cottonmouth strikes back at Luke by taking his vengeance out on the people of Harlem, while detectives Knight and Scarfe face an unexpected threat.

translations.value: Cottonmouth strikes back at Luke by taking his vengeance out on the people of Harlem, while detectives Knight and Scarfe face an unexpected threat.

episodes.name: Suckas need bodyguards
episodes.plot: After Cottonmouth and Scarfe's bloody clash, Luke realizes that saving the community may turn former allies into enemies, and enemies into allies.

translations.value: After Cottonmouth and Scarfe's bloody clash, Luke realizes that saving the community may turn former allies into enemies, and enemies into allies.

episodes.name: Manifest
episodes.plot: Mariah's political career comes under fire, and Cottonmouth picks up information that could put Luke on the run.

translations.value: Mariah's political career comes under fire, and Cottonmouth picks up information that could put Luke on the run.

episodes.name: Blowin' up the spot
episodes.plot: Mariah campaigns to turn the city and the police against Luke, and not even Misty or Claire may be able to save him.

translations.value: Mariah campaigns to turn the city and the police against Luke, and not even Misty or Claire may be able to save him.

episodes.name: DWYCK
episodes.plot: With Luke wounded and on the run, Misty faces a soul-searching interrogation. Mariah's rise to power takes a dark turn.

translations.value: With Luke wounded and on the run, Misty faces a soul-searching interrogation. Mariah's rise to power takes a dark turn.

episodes.name: Take it personal
episodes.plot: Luke gets closer to the truth about Reva and her part in his fate, while Mariah wrestles with the morality of her new role. Misty hunts for Luke.

episodes.plot: In one bold move, a friend from his past puts Luke on the defensive, Misty in dire straits, and Harlem's safety in jeopardy.

translations.title: Luke Cage
translations.overview: Dopo che un esperimento sabotato gli dona forza sovrumana e pelle indistruttibile, Luke Cage diventa un fuggitivo e cerca di ricostruire la sua vita ad Harlem, ma ben presto il passato torna a perseguitarlo.
Given superstrength and durability by a sabotaged experiment, a wrongly accused man escapes prison to become a superhero for hire.
translations.tagline: Hero is your word, not mine.

overview.value: Luke Cage veste i panni dell'invincibile difensore di Harlem e affronta politici corrotti e spietati gangster, oltre ai demoni del suo passato.
Mentre fama e responsabilità crescono, la vita di Luke Cage è sconvolta da un misterioso personaggio dotato di poteri speciali e con un piano per conquistare Harlem.
